reviews.text: The formula feels lightweight and comfortable while providing medium to high coverage that blurs pores and redness without looking thick. If you love the Korean “glass skin” trend but find dewy cushions too greasy, this is a great middle ground.
reviews.zh: 配方感覺輕身又舒服，同時提供中至高遮瑕度，可以修飾毛孔同泛紅，但又唔會望落厚。如果你鍾意韓式「玻璃肌」嘅潮流，但又覺得水光氣墊太油膩，呢個係一個好好嘅中間選擇。

reviews.text: i really love this cushion foundation, its super lightweight, yet provides coverage. i also really like the fact that, that the refill came with a puff. i have normal/dry skin with some redness , it covered everything super easily, i didnt need to use a concealer. the only thing i experienced, was that it need a sticky base (skincare or primer) to stick to, because when i was using it without a serum , it was separating, because there was nothing to stick to. overall a great product!
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢個氣墊粉底，佢超級輕身，但又做到遮瑕。我都好鍾意佢個補充裝連粉撲都有。我係中性／乾性肌，有少少泛紅，佢好輕鬆就遮晒，我完全唔需要用遮瑕膏。唯一遇到嘅情況係，佢需要一個黐立立嘅底（護膚品或者primer）先黐得到，因為我唔用精華直接用嘅時候，佢會分離，因為冇嘢可以黐住。整體嚟講係一個好正嘅產品！

reviews.text: The coverage was amazing! The formula was amazing, everything except the sponge was great. The sponge is not great to work with, i highly recommend changing the sponge in this cushion to a new sponge
reviews.zh: 遮瑕度勁正！配方都好正，除咗個粉撲之外其他都好好。個粉撲唔好用，我強烈建議換咗呢個氣墊嘅粉撲。

reviews.text: I love the finish of this and how it lasted throughout the day. Super natural yet good coverage and no oxidation! However I was super bummed to discover that it breaks me out a little bit. Other than that it was perfect :/
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢個妝效，同埋佢撐到一日完結。超自然但遮瑕力唔錯，而且完全唔氧化！不過我超級失望發現用咗會爆少少瘡。除咗呢點之外，樣樣都完美 :/

reviews.text: It is not as long lasting nor does provide the best coverage but I bought it knowing all that. I love how my skin looks with this and love how natural it looks. Some base products has horrible blotchy spots but this one does not and looks natural even when it disappears at the end of the day.
reviews.zh: 持久度唔算高，遮瑕力都唔算最好，但我買嘅時候已經知道呢啲嘢。我好鍾意用咗之後皮膚嘅樣，同埋好自然。有啲底妝會斑斑駁駁好恐怖，但呢個唔會，就算到一日完結甩妝都仲係好自然。

reviews.text: i have this in the shade 02 which oxidizes a little bit darker so i’m trying 1.5. i have oily skin and it’s a lot more glowy than i thought but works well when my skin is feeling dry. it covers redness and acne well. the case is adorable but the puff is a bit small and uncomfortable. i love the extra stickers!
reviews.zh: 我用緊 02 色號，會氧化變深少少，所以試緊 1.5。我係油性肌，妝效比我諗中水光亮好多，但皮膚覺得乾嘅時候用就啱啱好。遮泛紅同暗瘡都遮得唔錯。盒好得意，但粉撲細細粒用得唔太舒服。額外送嘅貼紙好鍾意！

reviews.text: Puff is very inconvenient. I have normal-combo skin and found my self looking cakey really early on. Will try again later on with mote skin prep but for now my preferred cushion is the clio glow mesh one
reviews.zh: 粉撲好唔方便。我係正常至混合性肌，好快就已經睇落好厚重。遲啲可能會做好啲妝前打底再試，但暫時我最鍾意嘅氣墊係 clio 嘅 glow mesh 嗰款。

reviews.text: Got the lightest shade and all of them are warm toned. Im pale cool/ neutral and none of them suited me. The packaging is lovely and feels durable but the actual product is only warm toned and it feels drying on the skin so not suited to dry skin types.
reviews.zh: 揀咗最淺嘅色號，全部都係暖調。我膚色偏白，屬於冷調／中性調，冇一款啱我。包裝好靚，手感都好似好實淨，但實際產品只有暖調，上臉會覺得乾，所以唔啱乾性肌用。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
